tagline: A mega-capital, the Thousand Islands, and a cross-border triangle to Singapore.
summary: Jakarta pairs a congested coastal mega-capital with the Thousand Islands (Kepulauan Seribu) resort archipelago just offshore, while Batam sits on the high-frequency Singapore–Batam–Bintan cross-border triangle. Pioneer II suits the Thousand Islands and inner-harbour hops; Quanta-LR's hybrid range strengthens the cross-border and inter-island corridors.

competitive_landscape: The Thousand Islands are served by slow wooden boats and speedboats from Ancol and the marinas; Jakarta's coast is among the most congested in the world. The cross-border triangle to Singapore (via Batam and Bintan) runs on separate diesel ferries with slow check-in. Fast, clean relief on both the island runs and the cross-border legs is the open gap.
seasonality: The wet season (Nov–Mar) brings rougher Java Sea conditions; the dry season (Apr–Oct) is calmer. The Thousand Islands runs are sheltered enough for year-round operation with foiling smoothing the chop.
regulatory_note: Sea transport falls under Indonesia's KSOP / Directorate of Sea Transportation and the DKI Jakarta administration; cross-border legs touch Indonesian and Singaporean immigration at established terminals.

precedents.why_it_matters: Regional proof that clean island mobility scales — applicable to the Thousand Islands and cross-border corridors.
